title: 第3章 吸血鬼第4章 躲避
content_zh:
那瞳孔里没有一丝人类该有的眼白，几乎整个眼球都被一种血红色占据，直接与凯撒来了个四目相对。
那对视的瞬间，一股寒意直冲天灵盖，凯撒甚至能看清对方眼球表面，密密麻麻的血丝在诡异蠕动，这绝不是人类的眼睛！
求生的本能压倒了一切，他身体猛地向后弹起，直接退到洞穴深处最黑暗的角落退去，后背重重地撞上冰冷的石壁，带来一丝短暂的安全感。
凯撒死死盯着洞口，手里下意识地握紧了那根磨尖的木矛。
死寂。
洞外的脚步声停了，那诡异的嘶吼和喘息也消失了。
“轰——！
！”
一声巨响猛地爆发！
石壁剧烈地颤抖，洞口石头垒成的墙壁猛然坍塌，一个人影随着石壁的崩塌，面朝下地摔了进来。
凯撒猛地将长矛死死抵在胸前，矛尖微微颤抖，指向那个趴在地上一动不动的人影。
灰尘弥漫，视线有些模糊，但那轮廓……确实是人形。
他迅速抓起身边一块拳头大的石头，朝着那人影的后背狠狠砸了过去！
“砰！”
石头结结实实地砸在那人影的背上，发出一声闷响。
人影纹丝不动，连一声呻吟都没有。
凯撒的心沉了下去，但一种更深的诡异感开始蔓延。
他死死盯着地上的人，借着洞口坍塌后透进来的光线，他看清了那身熟悉的装束。
粗糙的兽皮，在关节和要害处缝着独特的树皮硬片，那是铁皮村村民的标志性护甲！
“是村子里的人！”

这发现让凯撒心里一阵火热，把这身装备扒下来立刻跑路！
这套护甲对他这种在荒野挣扎求生的人来说，无异于保命的宝贝。
但是很快理智占了上风，凯撒发现那人的手指甲，呈现出一种灰黑色，又长又尖，至少比正常人的指甲长出两三倍。
这家伙身上发生了某些未知的变化！
他当机立断，一把抓起旁边地上已经冻得硬邦邦的烤鸡，紧紧攥在手里，另一只手则牢牢握着木矛。
脚步极其轻缓地向洞口挪去，坍塌的石块堵住了大半洞口，那人趴伏的身体正好卡在相对宽敞的一侧通道上。
凯撒屏住呼吸，眼睛盯着那毫无动静的身影，他几乎是贴着洞壁，一点点蹭过了那具身体。
就在成功出去准备离开时，心中的贪婪又想起了一道声音。
“那身护甲！
那身能救命的东西就在眼前！
就这样放弃？”
凯撒猛地收住脚步，停在洞口边缘，目光在那具“尸体”
和洞外灰暗的森林间来回扫视，最终贪婪战胜了恐惧。
content_en:
There was no trace of white in the pupils that humans should have, and almost the entire eyeball was occupied by a blood-red color, directly making eye contact with Caesar.
The moment they looked at each other, a chill went straight to the sky. Caesar could even see clearly the surface of the other person's eyeballs. The dense blood threads were moving strangely. These were definitely not human eyes!
The instinct to survive overwhelmed everything else. His body suddenly jumped back and retreated directly to the darkest corner of the cave. His back hit the cold stone wall heavily, bringing a brief sense of security.
Caesar stared at the hole, subconsciously clenching the sharpened wooden spear in his hand.
Dead silence.
The footsteps outside the cave stopped, and the weird roars and gasps disappeared.
“Boom——!
! "
A loud noise suddenly broke out!
The stone wall trembled violently, and the stone wall at the entrance of the cave suddenly collapsed. A figure fell in face-down as the stone wall collapsed.
Caesar suddenly pressed the spear against his chest, the tip of the spear trembling slightly, pointing at the motionless figure lying on the ground.
The dust was thick and the vision was a little blurry, but the outline... was indeed humanoid.
He quickly grabbed a fist-sized stone next to him and smashed it hard at the figure's back!
"Bang!"
The stone hit the figure firmly on the back, making a muffled sound.
The figure didn't move at all, not even a groan.
Caesar's heart sank, but a deeper sense of strangeness began to creep in.
He stared at the person on the ground, and through the light that came in after the cave entrance collapsed, he could clearly see the familiar attire.
Rough animal skin, with unique hard bark pieces sewn on the joints and vital parts, is the iconic armor of the villagers of Ironhide Village!
"It's from the village!"
This discovery made Caesar feel hot. He took off the equipment and ran away immediately!
This set of armor is a life-saving treasure for people like him who are struggling to survive in the wilderness.
But soon reason prevailed, and Caesar discovered that the man's fingernails were gray-black, long and pointed, at least two or three times longer than normal human nails.
Something unknown has happened to this guy!
He made a prompt decision and grabbed the roast chicken that was frozen hard on the ground next to him. He held it tightly in his hand while holding the wooden spear firmly in his other hand.
He moved extremely slowly towards the entrance of the cave. Collapsed stones blocked most of the entrance, and the man's prone body was stuck in the relatively spacious passage on one side.
Caesar held his breath and stared at the motionless figure. He almost pressed against the wall of the cave, rubbing against the body bit by bit.
Just when he was about to leave successfully, Greed in his heart remembered another voice.
"That armor!
That life-saving thing is right in front of you!
Just give up? "
Caesar suddenly stopped and stopped at the edge of the cave entrance, looking at the "corpse"
Glancing back and forth between the dark forest outside the cave, greed finally defeated fear.
